description: Use this when a visitor asks how often a ride breaks down or which rides at a park are least reliable. Returns 30-day uptime percentage, outages per day, and average and longest outage, least reliable first. Resolve the park ID first.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

ride_id.description: Optional canonical ride ID to return one ride only.

name: parky_get_ride_reliability
title: Get ride reliability
